search_intent.intent: Unmeasured country-specific research hypothesis: interpret ABS national and regional labour-market series for an Australia-focused senior-role search without inferring executive-specific demand.
evidence: ABS publishes national Labour Force Survey estimates and a separate modelled Regional Labour Force series for SA4 areas; their scope and estimation methods differ.

intended_audience: Senior executives and candidates researching the Australian employment market.
geographic_relevance: Australia only. Distinguishes national survey estimates from modelled SA4 regional estimates.

competitor_research.name: Australia-localized candidate-facing search results and direct market-guide competitors
competitor_research.finding: A current Australia-localized search-results review and direct competitor comparison was not performed.

commercial_relevance: Potential country-specific candidate research resource only if a distinct user need, demand, overlap and KOV serviceability are later established. ABS data availability does not establish commercial value or KOV capability.
unique_content_purpose: Help senior candidates distinguish the ABS household survey's broad national estimates from modelled SA4 regional estimates and understand why neither alone measures executive hiring demand.
duplication_and_cannibalisation_assessme: The existing executive job-search resource is jurisdiction-neutral. This draft focuses on the ABS Labour Force Survey, trend/seasonal/original series and modelled SA4 regional estimates. Existing Australia market coverage and full page-level overlap remain to be reviewed; a separate route requires evidence of a distinct user task and demand.
